dedupe_keys.name: renewable cost of capital analysis and figure scripts

description: The renewable-finance team archives scripts for analysing the global renewable project cost-of-capital database and reproducing its published figures. The Zenodo software record states that the ZIP contains the analysis code and a README. Public access is free under MIT. The package can provide a starting point for aggregating heterogeneous financing estimates before energy-system capacity-planning studies using tools such as model-pypsa-eur. A caveat is that the metadata do not expose the internal script language, dependency versions or a general-purpose command interface. The code was produced for one assembled table, so transferring it to newer finance sources may require changes to fields and assumptions. The repository metadata and manifest were inspected, but the ZIP was not downloaded and neither the analysis nor figures were reproduced. The underlying data are a distinct Figshare resource.
